explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and is above 0 only at D2 when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by the common transition: it is 10 when this a1 choice is a switch from a2 on the previous trial, and 2-7 on the next a1-to-S1 trial right after that switch. It is about 2-5 when the agent stays on a1 after an unrewarded trial, 0-1 when it stays on a1 after a rewarded one, and 0 whenever it chose a2 or the transition was rare.
